name: Insertion sort
description: Build a sorted prefix one item at a time.

name: Binary search
description: Narrow a sorted range until the target is found.

name: In-order traversal
description: Visit the left subtree, root, and right subtree in order.

name: Breadth-first search
description: Visit graph nodes level by level.

name: Generate permutations
description: Build every ordering by trying and undoing each choice.

name: Activity selection
description: Choose the next activity that finishes earliest.

name: Reservoir sampling
description: Select a uniformly random item from a stream.
